requirements.requirement: Create the platform group on node1.
requirements.summary: The group was created and directly observed as platform:x:1000: both before and after the restart.

requirements.requirement: Create /srv/platform as a workspace where platform group members can collaborate.
requirements.summary: The directory is root:platform with mode 2770 and default group-write ACL inheritance. Files created under a restrictive umask inherited group platform and mode 660, and a second group identity successfully appended to them before and after restart.

requirements.requirement: Ensure users outside the platform group have no access to /srv/platform.
requirements.summary: Directory and default ACL entries grant no permissions to others, and independent nonmember identities received permission denied in pre-restart, post-restart, and final functional tests.

overall_summary: All material task outcomes are satisfied with direct configuration and behavioral evidence. The platform group and collaborative, nonmember-isolated workspace persisted across a fully evidenced node restart, and verification artifacts were cleaned up.

operational_hygiene.summary: No unnecessary mutations were identified. Group, directory, and ACL changes directly implemented the task; proof files and temporary output supported bounded functional verification and were removed; and the reboot served the mandatory restart-evidence protocol. Final evidence confirms an empty workspace, no failed services, unchanged network exposure, and healthy package state. Restart evidence is complete: pre-restart boot identity and healthy task state, acknowledgement, a different post-restart identity, running system state, matching persisted data, and recovered access behavior, independently corroborated by lifecycle boot observations.
